meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会读你给的文本，按 12 个认知维度各打 1–10 分，产出维度评分、张力对照图、推理路径、决策风格和关键引文。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某人的思维方式、做认知画像，或提到 “DHDNA”“thinking pattern” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字作者的思维方式
say.note: 输出 12 维度评分与思维轮廓

say.text: 用 DHDNA 给我做一份认知画像
say.note: 基于本次对话文本评分

say.text: 比较这两篇文章作者的思维差异
say.note: 各自出画像，再给对比综合

howto.what_en: Claude reads the text you provide, scores 12 cognitive dimensions from 1-10, and returns dimension scores, a tension map, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, and key quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze how someone thinks, want a cognitive profile, or mention "DHDNA", "thinking pattern", or compare authors' styles.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text's author
Make me a DHDNA cognitive profile
Compare the thinking styles of these two authors
